# 3D Car Viewing

> Browser 3D car showroom. Next.js, React Three Fiber, and Three.js load GLB cars, discover doors, lights, and wheels from mesh names, and restore a view from URL query parameters. Source code is MIT. Bundled GLB models are third-party and are not MIT.

Version 0.3.0. Live demo: https://jiaxiantao.github.io/3d-car-viewing/ . Repository: https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing . 中文名：3D 看车。

## Start here

- [Live demo](https://jiaxiantao.github.io/3d-car-viewing/): Interactive showroom. No install required.
- [Agent brief](https://jiaxiantao.github.io/3d-car-viewing/llms-full.txt): Commands, URL contract, car list, and license boundary.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing): Clone target for coding agents.
- [Citation](https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Citation File Format entry for the MIT source.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing/blob/main/README.md): Features, setup, shortcuts, and model table.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Where to edit code when extending the showroom.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing/blob/main/documentation/ARCHITECTURE.md): Load pipeline, venues, and state ownership.
- [GLB rig guide](https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing/blob/main/documentation/market-glb-rig.md): Mesh naming required for doors, lights, and wheels.
- [Attribution](https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing/blob/main/documentation/ATTRIBUTION.md): Third-party model licenses. Read this before redistributing GLBs.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/jiaxiantao/3d-car-viewing/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history. Current release is 0.3.0.
